powers.name: Call Creatures
powers.effect: You call a number of simple-minded creatures within range to travel to your location.

powers.name: Call Item
powers.effect: You summon a specially prepared item to instantly appear in your hand.

powers.name: Chameleon
powers.effect: You cause reality to blur around you, distorting your image and allowing you to blend in with your surroundings.

powers.name: Déjà Vu
powers.effect: You create a brief memory loop in the mind of the target, causing their thoughts to slip back several seconds in time.

powers.name: Distort Vision
powers.effect: With this power, you disappear and your image reappears in another space no more than 10 metres away.

powers.name: Dull Pain
powers.effect: You can nullify the pain of any creature, including yourself, within Range.

powers.name: Fearful Aura
powers.effect: You twist reality in such a way as to make you appear more sinister and dangerous.

powers.name: Flash Bang
powers.effect: You create a bright flash of light and a deafening bang.

powers.name: Float
powers.effect: You focus your concentration and slowly begin to lift off the ground.

powers.name: Forget Me
powers.effect: You become instantly forgettable to a single creature within range.

powers.name: Healer
powers.effect: You channel your power into a single target to knit flesh and mend bones.

powers.name: Inflict Pain
powers.effect: You cause a person to be wracked with agony, filling their minds with unspeakable pain.

powers.name: Inspiring Aura
powers.effect: You seem to glow with an inner light and all those around you are filled with confidence.

powers.name: Knack
powers.effect: You tap into your unconscious to awaken a deeper understanding of your capabilities.

powers.name: Lucky
powers.effect: It is said that luck acts strangely around Psykers, no doubt in part to powers like this one.

powers.name: Precognition
powers.effect: You get a fuzzy picture of what will occur a few moments into the future.

powers.name: Psychic Stench
powers.effect: By momentarily handling an item you imbue it with an unnatural psychic smell.

powers.name: Resist Possession
powers.effect: You create mental wards to shield your mind from the malign denizens of the warp.

powers.name: Sense Presence
powers.effect: Reaching out with your mind, you get a vague inkling of other life forms within range.

powers.name: Spasm
powers.effect: You cause a target’s muscles to spasm.

powers.name: Spectral Hands
powers.effect: You create an invisible force that you can use to manipulate any object within 30 metres.

powers.name: Staunch Bleeding
powers.effect: You cause yourself or another creature within Range to halt Blood Loss.

powers.name: Torch
powers.effect: By burning the very stuff of your thoughts, you create a ball of glowing psy-flame.

powers.name: Touch of Madness
powers.effect: You reach into the mind of a target within Range and force them to believe something that just isn’t true.

powers.name: Unnatural Aim
powers.effect: You draw upon the power of the warp to guide your aim.

powers.name: Wall Walk
powers.effect: You bend gravity to your will.

powers.name: Warp Howl
powers.effect: You send out a long, keening screech throughout the warp that tears through into reality in a cacophonous burst.

powers.name: Weaken Veil
powers.effect: You weaken the fabric of space within 30 metres by drawing the immaterium closer.

powers.name: Weapon Jinx
powers.effect: You reach into nearby machines with your mind to scramble their circuitry.

powers.name: White Noise
powers.effect: You fill the warp with static, fouling psychic detection and making tech sensors less reliable.

powers.name: Wither
powers.effect: You cause a vile wave of invisible pestilence to emerge from your body, extending out to the Range of the power.

powers.name: Bio-lightning
powers.effect: You channel your life force through the meridians of your body, causing your form to crackle with living energy.

powers.name: Blood Boil
powers.effect: With a rhythmic crushing gesture, you tune into an enemy’s body, flexing their heart muscles to accelerate their pulse.

powers.name: Cellular Control
powers.effect: You learn various ways of transcending your body’s natural limitations by balancing your humors, modifying cellular structure and meditating upon the meridians of your body.

powers.name: Constrict
powers.effect: With a word, thought or gesture, you can command the flesh of your target to sharply contract.

powers.name: Enhanced Senses
powers.effect: With a moment’s thought, you force your senses into impossible feats of perception that can only be equalled among humans by the biomechanically augmented.

powers.name: Hammerhand
powers.effect: Biomancers who have learned to channel the fierce power of the warp into their limbs can eventually master the art of letting the energy of the immaterium flow unhindered through their body, phenomenally increasing their fighting capabiliti

powers.name: Regenerate
powers.effect: One of the pinnacles of a biomancer’s abilities, this power allows you to knit your flesh back together at a phenomenal rate, letting you swiftly overcome any non-fatal injury.

powers.name: Seal Wounds
powers.effect: You focus your power to repair your damaged flesh or that of any character within Range.

powers.name: Shape Flesh
powers.effect: Shape Flesh is the point where your flesh and will become indistinguishable—the goal of many a biomancer.

powers.name: Toxic Siphon
powers.effect: You draw poisons from the flesh.

powers.name: Divine Shot
powers.effect: Using this power enables you to make near impossible ranged shots, allowing you to strike virtually any target you can perceive.

powers.name: Dowsing
powers.effect: By focusing his mind the diviner can single out an object or person somewhere in his immediate vicinity, pushing aside all other distractions until he can unerringly find it.

powers.name: Far Sight
powers.effect: Some diviners are capable of opening their inner eye to perceive events that occur at places far away from them.

powers.name: Glimpse
powers.effect: You peer into the future, sensing the manifold web of different possible pathways and potential outcomes.

powers.name: Precognitive Strike
powers.effect: Like a spider on a web, you are able to sense disturbances to your immediate future.

powers.name: Precognitive Dodge
powers.effect: You may manipulate probability to your own advantage.

powers.name: Awareness
powers.effect: Casting your perception from the limited vessel of your bodily senses, you gain an unnatural awareness of the world around you.

powers.name: Psychometry
powers.effect: Intense displays of emotion leave a psychic “residue” on objects and places exposed to them.

powers.name: Personal Augury
powers.effect: Personal Augury allows you to peer into the fate of a single, willing target.

powers.name: Soul Sight
powers.effect: Diviners are said to be able to read a person’s shifting aura, the ghost self they unconsciously project into the warp.

powers.name: Blinding Flash
powers.effect: You focus blazing mental energy into a single point within your mind before releasing it all in a burst of searing bright light, blinding anyone who sees you and is within Range.

powers.name: Burning Fist
powers.effect: With intense concentration, you wreathe your hands in waves of shimmering flame.

powers.name: Call Flame
powers.effect: One of the first powers commonly learned in this discipline is to summon fire with thought.

powers.name: Fire Bolt
powers.effect: Fire Bolt allows you to create bolts of flame with your mind and hurl them at your foes.

powers.name: Fire Storm
powers.effect: Fire Storm instantly creates an intense conflagration about your target as the air itself ignites, burning all within to cinders.

powers.name: Holocaust
powers.effect: A legendary ability that few pyrokinetics are strong enough to even wield, much less have the courage to use.

powers.name: Incinerate
powers.effect: Incinerate allows you to generate intense heat as well as flame.

powers.name: Sculpt Flame
powers.effect: You control the shape of the fires burning around you.

powers.name: Wall of Fire
powers.effect: A relatively blunt, but effective, ability in the pyrokinetic’s arsenal, this power allows you to place an immobile barrier of flame that lingers for as long as you will it.

powers.name: Catch Projectiles
powers.effect: You can use your telekinetic abilities to catch incoming projectiles.

powers.name: Fling
powers.effect: You can telekinetically lift an unattended object from the ground and fling it at a target.

powers.name: Force Barrage
powers.effect: This power functions as Force Bolt except you create one bolt per point of your Willpower Bonus.

powers.name: Force Bolt
powers.effect: Use this power to hurl a burst of tangible mental force at your opponent.

powers.name: Telekinesis
powers.effect: If Telekinesis is a sledgehammer, then Precision Telekinesis is a scalpel.

powers.name: Psychic Blade
powers.effect: A phenomenally complicated ability to master, this power allows you to project your will as a blade of psychic force.

powers.name: Psychic Crush
powers.effect: You can direct your Telekinetic power directly against your opponents, wrapping them in bands of force that constrict and crush the life out of them.

powers.name: Push
powers.effect: You gather a ball of telekinetic energy and direct it against any single target within range.

powers.name: Telekinetic Shield
powers.effect: You erect a field of telekinetic energy about you.

powers.name: Beastmaster
powers.effect: You may stretch out your thoughts to animals, becoming able to perceive their emotions and establish a rudimentary form of communication.

powers.name: Compel
powers.effect: One of the most direct of all “psyker mind tricks”, Compel allows you to force others into briefly acting against their own will.

powers.name: Dominate
powers.effect: One of the most infamous of all telepathic abilities, you reach out with your mind to seize control of another’s body.

powers.name: Inspire
powers.effect: You bolster your comrades by subtly implanting images of great courage, and masking various negative emotional stimuli, allowing them to swiftly shake off fears and doubts.

powers.name: Mind Scan
powers.effect: With this power, you can read a target’s mind, probing whatever secrets are hidden therein.

powers.name: Projection
powers.effect: You can send out your disembodied mind and spirit, allowing you to touch other minds from a great distance away.

powers.name: Psychic Shriek
powers.effect: A voice’s volume is limited to the realities of vocal capacity and a listener’s ability to hear.

powers.name: See Me Not
powers.effect: You erase your presence from the minds of others.

powers.name: Telepathy
powers.effect: You can send your thoughts into the minds of those around you.

powers.name: Terrify
powers.effect: You dredge up a person’s worst nightmare and project it directly into their mind, causing them to flee screaming.

powers.name: Astral Telepathy
powers.effect: As part of the Soul Binding process, astropaths become able to send and receive messages across vast distances using the warp as a medium.

powers.name: Mental Bond
powers.effect: With a successful Focus Power Test, the psyker can create a permanent Fettered Strength telepathic connection to another being.

powers.name: Mind’s Eye
powers.effect: This technique allows the psyker to increase the range of all of his Telepathic communications (with the exception of Astro- telepathy) by a factor of 10.

powers.name: Mind Link
powers.effect: A successful Focus Power Test allows the psyker to create a Fettered Strength telepathic communication link for a number of willing minds up to his Willpower Bonus at the same time.

powers.name: Mind Probe
powers.effect: This technique allows the psyker to peel back the layers of another’s mind to read the basic surface thoughts and beyond.

powers.name: Mind Scan
powers.effect: The psyker extends his mind to contact and identify other sentient minds within range.

powers.name: Psychic Scream
powers.effect: By focusing all of his will behind one massive psychic scream, the psyker can injure or stun an opponent out to a range of 5m x Psy Rating.

powers.name: Short Range Telepathy
powers.effect: A successful Focus Power Test allows the psyker to establish and maintain a single telepathic connection to another character at Unfettered Psychic Strength.

powers.name: Terrify
powers.effect: By using his psychic abilities to intrude forcefully on another mind, the psyker assails his target with raw fear and horrific imagery.

powers.name: Beastmaster
powers.effect: The psyker can establish rudimentary control over animals.

powers.name: Compel
powers.effect: The next level of compulsion, this technique allows the psyker to force others to briefly act against their will.

powers.name: Delude
powers.effect: One of the simpler Telepathic tricks, Delude allows the psyker to subtly mask his intentions and manipulate others into reacting favourably to him for a short time.

powers.name: Dominate
powers.effect: The psyker has gained the most infamous power attributed to witches and renegades, the control of another’s mind.

powers.name: Inspire
powers.effect: The psyker can bolster his comrades by sending out waves of reassurance and martial spite.

powers.name: Puppet Master
powers.effect: This rare and dreaded power takes psychic domination to its final expression.

powers.name: Reprogram
powers.effect: Requiring utmost skill and experience, this technique enables the psyker to enter into another mind and completely reprogram the contents, insidiously reshaping its memories and experiences as he desires.

powers.name: Sensory Deprivation
powers.effect: The psyker has learned how to block the messages of the target’s senses.

powers.name: Augury
powers.effect: By reading the Emperor’s Tarot for a specific individual, the psyker can grant insight into what troubles lay ahead.

powers.name: Blessed by the Emperor
powers.effect: At this level of skill, the psyker has learned how to explore multiple outcomes to different choices and actions, and to be able to sort through them to choose the safest course.

powers.name: Divining the Future
powers.effect: Divining the Future represents the psyker’s growing affinity for the Emperor’s Tarot, and his ability to access answers about the future with greater speed and precision.

powers.name: Foreshadow
powers.effect: Peering in to the future for a brief instant, the psyker is able to see possible outcomes and potential dangers.

powers.name: In Harm’s Way
powers.effect: By taking a deep look into the near future, the psyker can anticipate the actions of his enemies.

powers.name: Psycholocation
powers.effect: By succeeding at a Psyniscience Test, the psyker can locate and track down a single object or person in his immediate vicinity.

powers.name: Psychometry
powers.effect: Learning to read the Tarot is in part the act of learning to divine the Emperor’s word from psychic impressions.

powers.name: Walking the Path
powers.effect: At this level of skill, the psyker has learned how to explore multiple outcomes to different choices and actions, and to be able to sort through them in less than a heartbeat.

powers.name: Force Bolt
powers.effect: The psyker can hurl a bolt of force at an opponent.

powers.name: Telekinetic Crush
powers.effect: The psyker can wrap a target in crushing bands of force.

powers.name: Telekinetic Weapon
powers.effect: Shaping the force of the psyker’s mind into a blade of destructive force, the Telekinetic Weapon is a powerful manifestation of

powers.name: Precision Telekinesis
powers.effect: Unlike the first gross manipulations of Telekinesis, this allows the psyker to fine tune his ability until he can do anything at range that he could do with his bare hands.

powers.name: Telekinetic Shield
powers.effect: The psyker can create a field of telekinetic energy for self- defence.

powers.name: Force Shards
powers.effect: This technique is an elegant manifestation of the psyker’s killing will in the form of multiple hovering blades of destructive force, visible as hazy distortions in the air.

powers.name: Storm of Force
powers.effect: The psyker has developed his powers to the furthest reaches.

powers.name: Astrotelepathy
powers.effect: Librarians can use their gifts to send psychic messages and communications across the vastness of the void in the same manner as an Astropath.

powers.name: Dominate
powers.effect: The psyker may take over the mind of another, controlling his victim with his will.

powers.name: Inspire
powers.effect: The psyker can bolster his comrades by sending out waves of reassurance and calm.

powers.name: Long-range Telepathy
powers.effect: This functions just the same as Short-range Telepathy, but with an extended range.

powers.name: Mind Probe
powers.effect: This power allows the psyker to peel back the layers of another’s mind to read the basic surface thoughts and beyond.

powers.name: Mind Scan
powers.effect: The psyker extends his mind to contact and identify other sentient minds within range, even if they are out of sight, enabling him to garner impressions and information about the consciousnesses.

powers.name: Short-range Telepathy
powers.effect: The psyker can send his thoughts into the minds of those around him, touching a number of targets equal to his PR.

powers.name: Augury
powers.effect: By reading the Emperor’s Tarot for a specific individual, the psyker can grant insight into what troubles lay ahead.

powers.name: Divination
powers.effect: The psyker can use this power to locate and track down a single object or person in his immediate vicinity.

powers.name: Psychometry
powers.effect: Learning to read the Emperor’s Tarot is in part the act of learning to divine the Emperor’s word from psychic impressions.

powers.name: Avenger
powers.effect: The Librarian summons up the ancestors of his Chapter and shapes them into a flaming vengeful avatar of death.

powers.name: Force Dome
powers.effect: Summoning up a shimmering field of force, the Librarian fashions a shell around himself and nearby allies.

powers.name: The Gate of Infinity
powers.effect: Rending the veil between worlds, the Librarian creates a rift through which he and his allies might pass.

powers.name: Iron Arm
powers.effect: The Librarian sheathes his arm in an impenetrable field of energy with the power to ward off powerful melee attacks.

powers.name: Machine Curse
powers.effect: The Librarian calls down a terrible curse on nearby machines and vehicles.

powers.name: Might of the Ancients
powers.effect: Tapping into the deadly powers of the Immaterium, the Librarian infuses himself with psychic energy increasing his psychical prowess and strength of arms to exceptional levels.

powers.name: Smite
powers.effect: The Librarian conjurers up lethal bolts of lightning that leap from his hands to burn and blast his enemies into ash.

powers.name: Veil of Time
powers.effect: The Librarian attempts to predict the near future, seeing the flow of events and the actions of others.

powers.name: Vortex of Doom
powers.effect: With an utter disregard for reality, the Librarian opens up a flickering vortex in the fabric of space and time.

powers.name: Blood Boil
powers.effect: With a blast of psychic power, the Librarian superheats the target’s blood, flash-boiling it and causing it to burst from their eyes, mouth, and ears.

powers.name: Blood Lance
powers.effect: The Librarian throws out his arm and hurls a blazing crimson lance that impales anything in its path.

powers.name: Fear the Darkness
powers.effect: Casting a psychic shadow across the battlefield, the Librarian fills his foes with intense dread and terror.

powers.name: Might of Heroes
powers.effect: Focusing his will, the Blood Angels Librarian enhances his strength and summons up a deep well of rage.

powers.name: Shackle Soul
powers.effect: Reaching into the soul of his foe, the Librarian binds it in powerful bands of psychic energy.

powers.name: Wings of Sanguinius
powers.effect: The Librarian sprouts a pair of blood red wings of psychic energy from his back that can bear him aloft.

powers.name: Force Barrier
powers.effect: Wrapping himself in a blanket of power, the Librarian creates a potent but static psychic shell over himself.

powers.name: Hellfire
powers.effect: The Librarian summons a torrent of psychic fire to burn and char his foes.

powers.name: Mask of Shadows
powers.effect: Covering his thoughts in darkness, the Librarian hides his mind from sight, confounding the efforts of enemy psykers or fearsome foes to psychically engage him.

powers.name: Mind Worm
powers.effect: Driving deep into the target’s mind, the Librarian implants the seed of doubt and remorse, crippling the creature with indecision and guilt.

powers.name: True Strike
powers.effect: Deadly against those with the psychic gift, the effects of a True Strike can smash an enemy psyker’s mind to pieces.

powers.name: Weaken Resolve
powers.effect: The Dark Angels Librarian forces his way into the minds of his foes, robbing them of their will to fight and eroding whatever resistance they possess.

powers.name: Fury of the Wolf Spirits
powers.effect: The Rune Priest summons up the spirits of the Thunderwolves, Freki the Fierce and Geri the Cunning, unleashing them upon his foes.

powers.name: Storm Caller
powers.effect: The Rune Priest invokes the ancient rites of ice and snow, calling up a blizzard of psychic energy around himself and his allies.

powers.name: Tempest’s Wrath
powers.effect: In a fearsome display of power, the Rune Priest calls upon the spirits of wind, storm, and snow, tearing the air with gales and tempests.

powers.name: Ancestors’ Rage
powers.effect: Calling upon the talents of dead heroes, the Librarian instils within himself or another exceptional skill at arms.

powers.name: Call to Arms
powers.effect: Plunging his will into the Immaterium, the Librarian calls forth ancestral spirits to fight on his side, and summons up a number of ancestral warriors equal to his PR to fight for him.

powers.name: Hammer of the Emperor
powers.effect: With the power of an orbital barrage, the Librarian calls down a mighty hammer of psychic energy with the power to lay waste to entire towns.

powers.name: Mark of Scorn
powers.effect: The Librarian casts a curse upon one of his foes, marking him for death at the hands of the righteous.

powers.name: Fury of the Ancients
powers.effect: Calling upon the legends of his Chapter, the Librarian summons forth a ravening beast of ghostly flame and psychic energy.

powers.name: Glory of the Emperor
powers.effect: For the briefest of instants the Librarian channels the light of the Emperor, bathing all those nearby in His glory.

powers.name: Paragon
powers.effect: The Librarian lets his authority shine forth in a blaze of psychic energy, filling nearby allies with strength and resolve to emulate his glory.

powers.name: War Cry
powers.effect: With a terrifying cry, the Librarian demoralises and stuns nearby foes, forcing them to cower before his might.

powers.name: Word of the Emperor
powers.effect: The Librarian recites a sanctified prayer to the Emperor, speaking holy words that burn the minds of the unfaithful and cast out the spirits of the Warp.

powers.name: Endurance
powers.effect: Extending his will over his allies, the psyker reaches into their bodies to mend their ﬂesh and reinvigorate their will to ﬁght by ridding their bodies of fatigue.

powers.name: Life Leech
powers.effect: The psyker latches on to his target’s life force and tears it from the hapless victim’s body.

powers.name: Warp Speed
powers.effect: The immaterium ﬂows through the psyker, allowing him the means to defy the limits of time, hastening his movements and reﬂexes far beyond the range of any human.

powers.name: Smite
powers.effect: Called by many names, Smite is a common destructive power used throughout the galaxy by many different psykers.

powers.name: Iron Arm
powers.effect: The psyker’s ﬂesh transforms, hardening into a slick, living metal, weighing him down but also rendering him incredibly resistant.

powers.name: Enfeeble
powers.effect: The psyker lashes at his target with tendrils of Warp energy.

powers.name: Prescience
powers.effect: The psyker taps into the immaterium, using its energies to spread his senses over the battle, seeing what is, what has been, and what will be.

powers.name: Foreboding
powers.effect: The psyker’s awareness of the Warp grants him the means to elude his opponents’ attacks without needing to rely on mortal reﬂexes.

powers.name: Haemorrhage
powers.effect: Bypassing exterior defences, the psyker reaches his mind out into the body of his adversary, using the writhing power of the Warp to set a ﬁre deep within his victim’s ﬂesh.

powers.name: Precognition
powers.effect: Such is the psyker’s power that he has witnessed every action, every decision, that will bring his Squad to victory.

powers.name: Forewarning
powers.effect: The psyker’s mind skims the Warp for glimpses of the immediate future, seeking to prepare himself and his allies for any incoming threats.

powers.name: Misfortune
powers.effect: Staring down his unfortunate victim, the psyker simply snaps his ﬁngers, twisting the strands of his target’s fate.

powers.name: Perfect Timing
powers.effect: Tearing through the boundary to the Warp with his consciousness, the psyker begins to see vivid images of his foes’ future actions with an unnatural precision.

powers.name: Fiery Form
powers.effect: The psyker engulfs his own body in the ﬁre of the Warp.

powers.name: Fire Shield
powers.effect: With a sweep of his hand, the psyker surrounds himself with a wall of writhing ﬂame.

powers.name: Inferno
powers.effect: Channelling his rage into the ﬁres of the Warp, the psyker calls down a pillar of ﬂame upon his enemies.

powers.name: Flame Breath
powers.effect: A truly horrifying sight, the psyker faces his enemy, opening his eyes and mouth wide as torrents of psychic ﬂame spew forth from them at his target.

powers.name: Assail
powers.effect: With nothing but the power of his own mind, the psyker picks up a nearby object; lifting a plasteel barrel, ripping a metal pipe from a wall, or even tearing a boulder from the earth.

powers.name: Crush
powers.effect: The psyker extends his hand towards his foe and clenches his ﬁst.

powers.name: Spontaneous Combustion
powers.effect: The psyker reaches into the body of his foe, pooling his anger into his victim and igniting his rage with the powers of the Warp.

powers.name: Sunburst
powers.effect: The psyker pools his hate inside himself, channelling it into the power of the Warp.

powers.name: Molten Beam
powers.effect: The psyker extend his palm towards his enemy and unleashes a concentrated, white-hot beam of energy.

powers.name: Objuration Mechanicum
powers.effect: The psyker releases the havoc of the Warp into the orderly inner workings of nearby machines.

powers.name: Shockwave
powers.effect: The psyker slams his palms together and uses his considerable power to amplify the noise exponentially, creating a torrential shockwave.

powers.name: Telekine Dome
powers.effect: Extending his power over his allies, the psyker creates a shimmering dome of energy around them that deﬂects enemy ﬁre as effectively as any bunker.

powers.name: Gate of Infinity
powers.effect: Controlling the roiling nature of time and space in the Warp, the psyker can open a hole through the immaterium, bending the fabric of reality to his will.

powers.name: Vortex of Doom
powers.effect: Playing with impossible energies of the immaterium, the psyker uses his power to punch a hole in reality, opening a tear to the Warp.

powers.name: Mental Fortitude
powers.effect: The psyker uses his mastery of the human mind to bolster his allies in battle.

powers.name: Puppet Master
powers.effect: Focussing his telepathic ability, the psyker is able to fully extend his mind into the will of another.

powers.name: Psychic Shriek
powers.effect: The psyker draws in a deep breath, pulling the power of the Warp inside of his body.

powers.name: Dominate
powers.effect: The psyker extends his will into the mind of his enemies, twisting around their thoughts and beating down their mental defences.

powers.name: Invisibility
powers.effect: The psyker worms his way into his opponents’ senses, causing even their sight to betray them.

powers.name: Hallucination
powers.effect: As with many things, the mind is much easier to break than it is to control.

powers.name: Terrify
powers.effect: Slithering deep into the mind of his victim, the psyker unearths their greatest failings, greatest weaknesses, and greatest fears.

powers.name: Frazzle
powers.effect: Thunderbolts of crackling green energy arc into the ranks of the Weirdboy’s enemies, scorching their ﬂesh and boiling their blood.

powers.name: Warpath
powers.effect: Brilliant bolts of green lightning arc from the Weirdboy to the Orks around him, invigorating and enlivening them with a frantic need for violence and savagery.

powers.name: Zzap
powers.effect: A beam of incandescent green Waaagh!

powers.name: Abhorrent Ward
powers.effect: The Sorcerer’s tainted soul draws to it the denizens of the warp, who clamour to his presence.

powers.name: Doombolt
powers.effect: Known by a variety of names, the Doombolt is a common destructive power utilised by a great many Chaos magos to strike down their foes.

powers.name: Foul Cage
powers.effect: Great long bonds of warp-spawned ropes, chains, and lengths of barbed sinew erupt from the ground

powers.name: Gift of Chaos
powers.effect: The Sorcerer tears a miniscule hole in reality for the briefest of moments, exposing a single foe to the full splendour of the warp.

powers.name: Hatestorm
powers.effect: The Sorcerer calls upon the dark gods to gift him with a portion of their own hatred, and becomes the crackling focus of an aura of dark energy.

powers.name: Host of Fiends
powers.effect: The veil between reality and the warp is made thin and porous, allowing even the least of daemons to scratch and claw at the edge of the universe, their distant shrieks and howls and the nightmarish images they produce tormenting all mortal

powers.name: Warptime
powers.effect: The timeless nature of the warp grants the cunning Sorcerer the means to defy the normal limits of time, hastening his movements and reﬂ exes such that his enemies appear to be moving in slow motion.

powers.name: Choir of Poxes
powers.effect: As enacted by Nurgle’s daemonic legions, the Sorcerer’s throat rattles with the names of every disease he has ever suffered from, and every disease that Nurgle has ever gifted mortals with.

powers.name: Inviolable Flesh
powers.effect: The Sorcerer’s ﬂ esh twists and changes to resemble the blessed efﬂ uents of the Plague God, becoming crusted with ﬁ lth and foulness such that the blows of the enemy do not cut so deep.

powers.name: Nurgle’s Rot
powers.effect: The grandest and most infamous of Nurgle’s contagions, Nurgle’s Rot is known by many names and has appeared on countless worlds, leaving entire populations desolated by this terrible daemonic pathogen.

powers.name: Field of Pestilence
powers.effect: While touching the ground beneath his feet, the Sorcerer conjures forth a wave of pestilence and decay, turning hardened soil into a morass of greenish-grey sludge.

powers.name: Putrefying Embrace
powers.effect: The Sorcerer reaches out with arms dripping in foulness, to corrupt anything he touches.

powers.name: Rain of Foulness
powers.effect: At the Sorcerer’s command, the skies ﬁ ll with brooding, discoloured clouds that split open and pour ﬁ lth and rotten blood down upon the Sorcerer’s foes.

powers.name: Acquiescence
powers.prerequisites: Devoted to Slaanesh, WP 50+, Psy Rating 4
powers.effect: The Sorcerer conjures a spark of delusion, overwhelming the target’s mind with contradictory thoughts and feelings that drive him to distraction, incapable of performing any action amidst the psychic fog.

powers.name: Ecstatic Oblivion
powers.prerequisites: Mark of Slaanesh, Toughness 40+, Psy Rating 4
powers.effect: The Sorcerer summons up every ﬂ ickering moment of stray emotion he can ﬁ nd within the Immaterium, and draws them into himself, overwhelming his own senses and rendering him oblivious to the sensations of battle around him.

powers.name: Hellshriek
powers.effect: The Sorcerer reaches deep into the warp and produces a soul-shattering noise that inﬂ icts terrible pain upon those that hear it.

powers.name: Lash of Submission
powers.effect: The Sorcerer projects a lurid, glowing cord of energy that wraps itself around his enemies, worming itself into their minds and overwhelming their will for a few brief moments.

powers.name: Soul’s Secrets Unleashed
powers.prerequisites: Mark of Slaanesh, WP 50+, Psy Rating 6
powers.effect: The Sorcerer becomes a mouthpiece for the inﬁ nite voice of Slaanesh, crawling deep into the mind of a chosen victim, calling forth the darkest desires from the depths of his victim’s soul, unleashing them and giving them free reign.

powers.name: Symphony of Pain
powers.prerequisites: Mark of Slaanesh, Toughness 40+, Psy Rating 4
powers.effect: The Sorcerer casts his arms wide, as if conducting a great orchestra of cavorting daemons that howl and dance around his echo within the Immaterium.

powers.name: Bolt of Change
powers.prerequisites: Mark of Tzeentch, WP 50+, Psy Rating 5
powers.effect: The Sorcerer focuses his will and his wrath into a searing bolt of warp-ﬂ ame—often red, due to the pervasive lore of the many-coloured ﬁ res of Tzeentch—that reduces enemies to twitching masses of mutating gore, or swirling whirlwinds of i

powers.name: Boon of Tzeentch
powers.effect: The Sorcerer reaches deep into the warp for greater power, bolstering his already potent abilities further.

powers.name: Flicker
powers.effect: The Sorcerer creates a shimmering ﬁ eld of unreality around him, his image becoming transparent and intermittent as he ﬂ ickers between reality and the warp.

powers.name: Gholam Curse
powers.effect: The Sorcerer reaches into the mind of an enemy, and bends their body to his will.

powers.name: Mantle of Lies
powers.effect: The Sorcerer calls upon the Weaver of Fates to bless him with the power of confusion.

powers.name: Mindscourge
powers.effect: At ﬁ rst, all the victim feels is a sharp stabbing pain in his head.

powers.name: Protean Form
powers.effect: The Sorcerer distends and warps his form into a new and horriﬁ c shape, channelling the power of Chaos into his own corrupt ﬂ esh to bless his enemies with a glorious image of change.

powers.name: Psyphon
powers.effect: The Sorcerer locks his gaze with a victim, drawing away his will and using that stolen mental strength to bolster his own.

powers.name: Vile Revelation
powers.prerequisites: Mark of Tzeentch, Perception 50+, Psy Rating 5
powers.effect: The Sorcerer feels the shifts and ﬂ ows of the warp keenly, and can discern brief slivers of events yet to come from this morass of swirling potential.

powers.name: Hellish Blast
powers.effect: The Sorcerer reaches into the warp for pure destructive force, gathering up raw hatred and the most concentrated spite.

powers.name: Maelstrom of Rage
powers.effect: The Sorcerer reaches deep into the warp, bringing forth the deepest, darkest rage and hatred he can ﬁ nd, unleashing it upon all those nearby.

powers.name: Shattertime
powers.effect: The Sorcerer draws upon the timeless nature of the warp and uses it to unravel the hindrances of linear time, stepping from moment to moment in no particular order.

powers.name: Sunder the Veil
powers.effect: The veil between reality and the warp is breached, allowing daemons to pour through and wreak havoc upon the material universe for a brief time.

powers.name: Compel
powers.effect: The psyker reaches into the target’s mind and forces him to perform an action against his will.

powers.name: Delude
powers.effect: The psyker clouds the target’s perceptions, tricking him into feeling that the psyker is someone to be trusted implicitly, reacting positively to interactions with him.

powers.name: Mind Link
powers.effect: A natural development of the simplest telepathic techniques, the psyker forms a lingering mental bond between himself and several others, allowing them to share thoughts over considerable distances.

powers.name: Mind Probe
powers.effect: The psyker reaches into the mind of a single creature, unravelling the layers and defences within it to uncover thoughts both obvious and hidden.

powers.name: Psychic Scream
powers.effect: The psyker’s mind unleashes a wave of psychic force that resonates in the target’s mind, inﬂ icting great pain that can injure or incapacitate an enemy.

powers.name: Thought Sending
powers.effect: The psyker can send his thoughts into the minds of those around him.

powers.name: Force Bolt
powers.effect: The psyker gathers up his will, coalescing it into a ﬁ st-sized bolt.

powers.name: Force Storm
powers.effect: The psyker’s will is extended out into a great ﬂ urry of bolts of invisible force, akin to a storm of ﬁ re from an automatic weapon.

powers.name: Mind Over Matter
powers.subtype: Attack (if used to throw target), Concentration
powers.effect: The basic talent of telekinesis is a versatile and immensely useful tool in any psyker’s arsenal, a valuable means of exerting his will upon his immediate surroundings.

powers.name: Precision Telekinesis
powers.effect: The true Telekine does not just manipulate large objects with clumsy force.

powers.name: Telekinetic Shield
powers.effect: The psyker constructs a barrier of denial and deﬁ ance that deﬂ ects the attacks of his enemies as if it were a solid object.

powers.name: Telekinetic Weapon
powers.effect: The psyker’s mind cuts deeper than any mortal blade, manifesting as an impossibly sharp blade of psychic force that shears through ﬂ esh and armour with contemptuous ease.

powers.name: Precognition
powers.effect: The psyker’s mind skims the warp for glimpses of the immediate future, seeking to discern threats to himself so that he may avoid them.

powers.name: Preternatural Awareness
powers.effect: The psyker’s perceptions are focussed on his immediate surroundings, searching for even the slightest disturbance or most minor change.

powers.name: Precognitive Dodge
powers.effect: The psyker’s awareness of the warp grants him the means to elude his opponents’ attacks without needing to rely on mortal reﬂ exes.

powers.name: Glimpse
powers.effect: The psyker reaches into the warp to grasp a single moment from the possible futures arrayed before him—a moment in which he succeeds at a particular task— and the trials and travails that could prevent that moment coming to pass.

powers.name: Precognitive Strike
powers.effect: To discern one’s own future is sometimes deemed easier than discerning the futures of others—to look for the echoes of one’s own soul, rather than those of unfamiliar foes.

powers.name: The Warp Unbound
powers.book: Rogue Trader — The Navis Primer (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: By gazing directly into the mind of a psyker, the Navigator is able to pierce the barrier between the psyker and the Warp, opening a door to the Empyrean and unleashing a storm a chaos that devastates his victim from within.

powers.name: Aether Doldrums
powers.book: Rogue Trader — The Navis Primer (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: A skilled Navigator can use this power to mark a point of calm in even the most tumultuous Warp storm.

powers.name: Baleful Watcher
powers.book: Rogue Trader — The Navis Primer (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: The power sometimes called “Baleful Watcher” or “Piercing Gaze” is a technique taught to Navigators to help them to penetrate the densest of Warpstorms and ﬁnd a safe path.

powers.name: Ebb and Flow
powers.book: Rogue Trader — The Navis Primer (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: Time can ﬂow in a strange manner when travelling through the Immaterium, and over the years many Navigators have learned to move with the temporal unpredictability of the Immaterium that underlies reality.

powers.name: Evil Eye
powers.book: Rogue Trader — The Navis Primer (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: On many worlds, three-eyed mutants who can peer into your soul are thought of as bogey-men to scare children into obedience and people whisper that they are a tainted breed that can curse good, Emperor-fearing citizens with but a glance.

powers.name: Eye of Oblivion
powers.book: Rogue Trader — The Navis Primer (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: The Navigator snaps open his Warp eye and traces the vital lines that bind a creature’s animating force to its mortal shell.

powers.name: Inward View
powers.book: Rogue Trader — The Navis Primer (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: There are many myths about the “third eye” into the soul, their origins supposedly harking from Old Terra itself.

powers.name: Pass Unscathed
powers.book: Rogue Trader — The Navis Primer (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: Being so closely linked with the Warp, it is no surprise that Navigators have developed techniques to avoid its corrupting inﬂuence on both themselves and those around them.

powers.name: Seek the Path
powers.book: Rogue Trader — The Navis Primer (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: The Navigator uses his pineal eye to peer through the Immaterium around him, piercing the churning clouds of the Warp to ﬁnd the causeways of least resistance to his target and assessing the paths of its reaction before it can even move to

powers.name: Vision of Hell
powers.book: Rogue Trader — The Navis Primer (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: While many Navigators simply focus on wreaking as much destruction as possible by revealing the Warp to their foes with powers like Lidless Stare, some Navigators prefer to act with more subtlety and train themselves to cast projections of

powers.name: Warp Vigil
powers.book: Rogue Trader — The Navis Primer (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: Navigators must be ever watchful for danger when guiding a vessel through the Warp, and be capable of reacting at a moment’s notice to the caprices of the shifting realm of Chaos.

powers.name: Embrace of Emptiness
powers.book: Rogue Trader — The Navis Primer (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: Within the depths of the void, it is not uncommon for a vessel to suffer a catastrophe that leaves its crew injured and the craft distant from any aid.

powers.name: Quest for Warmth
powers.book: Rogue Trader — The Navis Primer (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: Many psykers who embrace the Voidfrost Discipline do so as part of an effort to ﬁnd other minds amongst the expanse of the void.

powers.name: The Void’s Touch
powers.book: Rogue Trader — The Navis Primer (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: As a psyker’s relationship to the dark chill of the void grows stronger, he often gains the ability to draw upon its inherent nature.

powers.name: Breathstealing Barrage
powers.book: Rogue Trader — The Navis Primer (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: The void is tranquil, but that desolate quiet can kill.

powers.name: Black Sleep
powers.book: Rogue Trader — The Navis Primer (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: The embrace of the void can offer comfort to an isolated psyker, but those who master its ways soon discover that it can also be a powerful ally.

powers.name: Void Substantiation
powers.book: Rogue Trader — The Navis Primer (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: Through discipline, practice, and self-afﬁrmation a psyker can come to embody the chill of the void.

powers.name: Freeze the Soul
powers.book: Rogue Trader — The Navis Primer (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: There are few prodigies of the Voidfrost Discipline, but legends circulate of those who have completely mastered its ways.

powers.name: Know Thy Place
powers.book: Rogue Trader — The Navis Primer (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: Through the majesty of the God-Emperor, the psyker comes to understand his place in the galaxy, particularly with reference to the majesty of the God-Emperor and the terrors of the Warp.

powers.name: Heresy’s Price
powers.book: Rogue Trader — The Navis Primer (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: Those who oppose the God-Emperor cannot hope to stand before His majesty.

powers.name: Bastion of the Imperium
powers.book: Rogue Trader — The Navis Primer (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: A psyker who has begun to master the discipline of Soul Warding may pass the protection of the God-Emperor on to those who most need it.

powers.name: Chorus of the Righteous
powers.book: Rogue Trader — The Navis Primer (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: Drawing upon his connection to the God-Emperor through his Soul Binding, the psyker may motivate his companions to ﬁght with ever greater fervour.

powers.name: Strength of Truth
powers.book: Rogue Trader — The Navis Primer (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: Those who choose to master the skills of the Soul Ward invariably have an incredible degree of trust in their abilities and in the cause of the God-Emperor.

powers.name: Enduring Faith
powers.book: Rogue Trader — The Navis Primer (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: It is said that the God-Emperor lends his strength to those who display the faith required to help themselves.

powers.name: Reward of the Renegade
powers.book: Rogue Trader — The Navis Primer (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: Those who would dare to act against the Imperium do so with the knowledge that they are in opposition to the divinely mandated will of the God Emperor.

powers.name: Glory of the Just
powers.book: Rogue Trader — The Navis Primer (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: As an Astropath’s mastery of the Soul Ward school grows, so to do the methods by which he may grant the Emperor’s blessing upon his allies.

powers.name: Call of Faith
powers.book: Rogue Trader — The Navis Primer (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: Those who have faith in the God-Emperor are often capable of performing actions of superhuman endurance.

powers.name: Mental Force
powers.book: Rogue Trader — The Navis Primer (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: One of the most common ways that a person can ﬁrst exhibit psychic abilities is with a powerful blast of mental energy.

powers.name: Defraud
powers.book: Rogue Trader — The Navis Primer (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: Some untrained psykers ﬁrst exercise their blasphemous powers when they desperately need to convince someone of something.

powers.name: Mind’s Shadow
powers.book: Rogue Trader — The Navis Primer (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: Isolation is second nature to some people.

powers.name: Alter Memories
powers.book: Rogue Trader — The Navis Primer (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: As novice psykers come to grips with their newfound talents, they often begin to dabble with their powers.

powers.name: Ætheric Appendage
powers.book: Rogue Trader — The Navis Primer (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: With sufﬁcient practice and control, any psyker can learn to manifest his Warp-spawned powers with ﬁnesse rather than with simple brute force.

powers.name: Desperate Transmogriﬁcation
powers.book: Rogue Trader — The Navis Primer (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: Sometimes, desperation drives renegade psykers to attempt to heal themselves or comrades by infusing the raw power of the Warp into an injury.

powers.name: Incite Rage
powers.book: Rogue Trader — The Navis Primer (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: As the psyker is increasingly exposed to the Warp, he may begin to embrace its savage aspects.

powers.name: Shifting Lines of Fate
powers.book: Rogue Trader — The Navis Primer (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: Those who learn to live in concert with the Warp often choose to accept its ﬁckle nature.

powers.name: Warp Lens
powers.book: Rogue Trader — The Navis Primer (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: Even those who have come to master the ways of the Warp often maintain unreasonable expectations for the secrets that it might surrender.

powers.name: Common Thoughts
powers.book: Rogue Trader — The Navis Primer (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: Many untrained psykers ascribe to a belief that the Warp holds boundless information and that all sentient creatures share a link to its nature.

powers.name: Shielded by the Warp
powers.book: Rogue Trader — The Navis Primer (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: Those who become servants of the Warp may often look to the Warp to protect them.

powers.name: Spiteshards
powers.book: Rogue Trader — The Navis Primer (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: With practice, a psyker may learn to coalesce his spite into something physical by translating it through the Warp, manifesting this power as a volley of razor-edged crystals of pulsating darkness that pierce through armour, corrupting anyt

powers.name: Warp Spasm
powers.book: Rogue Trader — The Navis Primer (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: With enough experience, many psykers learn to channel the Warp directly into their bodies to enhance their natural talents.

powers.name: Frazzle
powers.book: Rogue Trader — The Navis Primer (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: With a thunderous roar, the Weirdboy unleashes a blast of energy that courses through his target and leaps to those unfortunate enough to be standing near it.

powers.name: Up An’ at ‘em!
powers.book: Rogue Trader — The Navis Primer (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: The Weirdboy leads by insane example, psychically (and psychotically) inspiring his comrades to charge along with him even as he rushes towards a certain, grisly end.

powers.name: Warpath
powers.book: Rogue Trader — The Navis Primer (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: Crackling green energy surges out from the Weirdboy, striking the nearby Orks and stoking the ﬁres of their battle frenzy to devastating new heights.

powers.name: Dis Iz Takin’ Too Long!
powers.book: Rogue Trader — The Navis Primer (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: The Weirdboy calls upon the Waaagh!, channelling his impatience to accelerate whatever mode of transportation he happens to be using (be that his feet or a mighty voidship) in a swell of brilliant, crackling energy.

powers.name: Smash Da Gitz
powers.book: Rogue Trader — The Navis Primer (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: The Weirdboy energises his weapon (or just his ﬁst) with a voracious green charge that shreds through metal and ﬂesh alike when he strikes.

powers.name: We’z Gotta Be Lucky
powers.book: Rogue Trader — The Navis Primer (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.prerequisites: Smash da Gitz, Up an’ at Em!
powers.effect: The Weirdboy appeals to the primal force of the Waaagh!

powers.name: Zzap
powers.book: Rogue Trader — The Navis Primer (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: The Weirdboy unleashes a burst of ravening green electricity that surges forward, turning organic tissue to ash and the hardest alloys to molten slag.

powers.name: Deff Wave
powers.book: Rogue Trader — The Navis Primer (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: The Ork philosophy of warfare typically ascribes to a simple maxim: more is better and you can never have enough.

powers.name: Krump ‘em All
powers.book: Rogue Trader — The Navis Primer (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: The Weirdboy unleashes the fury of the Waaagh!

powers.name: I’z Gunna Squig Ya!
powers.book: Rogue Trader — The Navis Primer (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.prerequisites: Zzap, Dis is Takin’ Too Long
powers.effect: Of all the many powers available to a Weirdboy, this is undoubtedly one of the strangest.

powers.name: Beacon
powers.book: Rogue Trader — Into the Storm (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: With this power the psyker is able to create a small psychic beacon within the Empyrean that can only be seen with psychic senses.

powers.name: Chaos Mind
powers.book: Rogue Trader — Into the Storm (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: The psyker is able to form a bridge between his mind and the mind of the target.

powers.name: Mental Alacrity
powers.book: Rogue Trader — Into the Storm (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: Within the Scholastica Psykana and the Adeptus Astra Telepathica, there are many exercises and meditations that are taught to the psykers and Astropaths to enhance their senses and make up for the loss of their sight.

powers.name: Mind Ward
powers.book: Rogue Trader — Into the Storm (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: There are many ways to gain entry into the mind of another person.

powers.name: Auto-séance
powers.book: Rogue Trader — Into the Storm (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: Astropaths are far more than mere telepaths.

powers.name: Detect Taint
powers.book: Rogue Trader — Into the Storm (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: Psykers, by their very nature, are attuned to the warp.

powers.name: The Action Again
powers.book: Rogue Trader — Into the Storm (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: With this power, a psyker is able to snatch a glimpse of the future and see brieﬂy the outcome of his actions.

powers.name: Death Grip
powers.book: Rogue Trader — Into the Storm (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: Using the power of his mind, the psyker is able to create a telekinetic grip on a living creature’s vital organs and squeeze them.

powers.name: Levitation
powers.book: Rogue Trader — Into the Storm (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: The psyker is able to call upon his telekinetic abilities to be able to lift himself into the air.

powers.name: Psycho-kinetic Mist
powers.book: Rogue Trader — Into the Storm (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: By calling on the powers of the warp, the psyker is able to conjure up a psycho-kinetic material that can be shaped by the psyker’s mind.

powers.name: Psycho-kinetic Shield
powers.book: Rogue Trader — Into the Storm (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: The psyker is able to mentally shape a psycho-kinetic mist into a barrier capable of withstanding physical attacks.

powers.name: Banishment
powers.book: Rogue Trader — Into the Storm (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: By tapping into the ability to sense tenuous connections between the warp and warp–entities, the psyker is able to attack the ties and create a discordant resonance within them.

powers.name: Rebuke the Mutant
powers.book: Rogue Trader — Into the Storm (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: The foul mutant cannot bear to stand against he who has stood before the God–Emperor.

powers.name: Sanctuary
powers.book: Rogue Trader — Into the Storm (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: By tapping into the various breaches and cracks that exist in the real world, the psyker is able to wrap himself within tendrils of warp energy and use them to gird himself against harm.

powers.name: Seal the Breach
powers.book: Rogue Trader — Into the Storm (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: Seal the Breach allows the psyker to sever the connection between the mortal universe and the warp.

powers.name: Soul of Adamantium
powers.book: Rogue Trader — Into the Storm (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: The psyker’s mind is a powerful weapon, and the psyker with faith in the God-Emperor is doubly so.

powers.name: Warp Weapon
powers.book: Rogue Trader — Into the Storm (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: Psykers who possess undying faith in the God-Emperor are able to perform amazing feats that can only be done by creatures and beings not from this realm.

sources.coverage: ok — 24 powers from Dark Heresy - Ascension.md

powers.name: Lightning Arc
powers.effect: The psyker channels the warp into electric energy that crackles from his fingertips, burning through his foes.

powers.name: Lightning Field
powers.effect: The psyker surrounds himself in a cracking, sparking nimbus of electricity, daring his enemies to strike him.

powers.name: Lightning Storm
powers.effect: With charged air and the stench of ozone, the psyker reaches into the warp and lets forth a blast of etheric lightning.

powers.name: Malleus Hammerhand
powers.effect: The psyker’s hands glow with otherworldly power as they are infused with a terrible strength.

powers.name: Enrage
powers.effect: The psyker reaches into the minds of his opponents, momentarily crushing their psyche with a blank, murderous rage.

powers.name: Bloodboil
powers.effect: The psyker’s frenzy for destruction burns hot in his soul.

powers.name: My Will, Known
powers.effect: The psyker’s awareness radiates out like a blanket, suffusing the very atmosphere around him with his consciousness.

powers.name: My Will, Obeyed
powers.effect: The psyker projects his consciousness into another, fighting through the target as if wearing his flesh.

powers.name: My Will, Manifest
powers.effect: The psyker’s psyche leaves its fleshy prison, roaming free as an invisible being of etheric energy.

powers.name: Flameshroud
powers.effect: Should the pyrokinetic wish to survive his self-generated holocausts, he must learn to endure the flames he creates.

powers.name: Conflagration
powers.effect: The air around the psyker is choked with ash and cinders, swirling in an unseen wind.

powers.name: Inferno
powers.effect: Some of the most powerful pyrokinetics can wipe out whole hab-blocks or villages by summoning a true inferno.

powers.name: Banishment
powers.effect: The psyker focuses his mental powers on the bonds that tie the Daemon to the immaterium, snapping it with his indomitable will.

powers.name: Sanctuary
powers.effect: The glory of the God-emperor is channelled through the psyker, causing all who would strike him and those who stand with him to quail against the terrible radiance.

powers.name: Word of the Emperor
powers.effect: The psyker’s belief in the power of the Emperor is so strong, it overpowers the minds and wills of the Daemon and unbeliever.

powers.name: His Will Be Done
powers.effect: The psyker’s mind reaches out to the minds of his friends and allies.

powers.name: Hammer of Witches
powers.effect: The psyker reaches to the strings that connect a psyker to his source of power, the warp.

powers.name: Purgatus
powers.effect: The psyker’s sinister gaze pins a heretic in his sights, his potent will flaying the unfortunate’s mind until it is an empty husk.

powers.name: Lift
powers.effect: The most basic of the psychokinetic powers is the ability to move objects with one’s mind, and it is an ability that can be used in a wide variety of ways.

powers.name: Barrier
powers.effect: The psyker’s mind is so agile he is able to swat aside projectiles with a thought, causing them to deflect harmlessly mere inches from his skin.

powers.name: Tempest
powers.effect: The most powerful psychokinetics can agitate the very air around them, creating swirling vortexes of wind and debris.

powers.name: Precognition
powers.effect: One aspect of temporal manipulation that most often manifests in psykers is the ability of precognition—an ability to see the myriad possibilities of the future.

powers.name: Stasis Shell
powers.effect: The psyker creates a spherical area in which time seems to completely stop, leaving whatever is inside perfectly frozen in time.

powers.name: Warp Time
powers.effect: The most powerful psychic adepts of the temporal arts are able to speed and slow the passage of time, both for themselves, their allies, and their enemies.

powers.name: Endure Flames
powers.book: Dark Heresy — Disciples of the Dark Gods (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: You can endure the most severe flames, allowing you to walk unscathed through fire.

powers.name: Open Wounds
powers.book: Dark Heresy — Disciples of the Dark Gods (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: You can cause a previously injured victim’s wounds to burst open and gush with blood, rapidly exsanguinating them in an extremely messy fashion.

powers.name: Space Slip
powers.book: Dark Heresy — Disciples of the Dark Gods (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: You push yourself through the edge of the warp, slipping out of reality for a brief instant and reappearing in a different nearby location.

powers.name: Suggestion
powers.book: Dark Heresy — Disciples of the Dark Gods (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: You introduce a single telepathic suggestion into a target’s psyche, making him more open to a line of thought, experience a brief sensation, lend credence to what you are saying, or momentarily experience an emotional state of your choosin

powers.name: Time Fade
powers.book: Dark Heresy — Disciples of the Dark Gods (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: You remove yourself briefly from the normal flow of space and time, flickering briefly out of existence like a failing holo-lantern slide.

powers.name: Agony
powers.book: Dark Heresy — Disciples of the Dark Gods (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: Reaching out with your power, you lash out at your enemies with acute and all-consuming pain.

powers.name: Drain Vigour
powers.book: Dark Heresy — Disciples of the Dark Gods (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: You drain the vigour and energy of a living creature, sapping its vitality and strength, and ultimately incapacitating or even killing it.

powers.name: Flesh Like Iron
powers.book: Dark Heresy — Disciples of the Dark Gods (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: You draw on the power of the warp to make your flesh as hard as metal.

powers.name: Molten Man
powers.book: Dark Heresy — Disciples of the Dark Gods (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: You become a thing of pure heat and flame, a raging inferno with a humanoid form.

powers.name: Psychokinetic Storm
powers.book: Dark Heresy — Disciples of the Dark Gods (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: This power manifests an uncontrolled storm of unleashed psychokinetic potential around the psyker, raising a tumult of squalling winds from nowhere and causing small objects to jump and topple, glass to shatter, electrical contacts to short

powers.name: Seed Mind
powers.book: Dark Heresy — Disciples of the Dark Gods (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: This power allows you to subvert the minds of others by planting a seed of influence within a person’s mind; a psychic keyhole that you can use in the future to unlock their psyche and enslave their will to your own.

powers.name: Soul Killer
powers.book: Dark Heresy — Disciples of the Dark Gods (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: This baleful power slays the psyker’s enemies with an invisible splinter of annihilating psychic force.

powers.name: Zone of Compulsion
powers.book: Dark Heresy — Disciples of the Dark Gods (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: You send out a wave of telepathic force that carries a single command.

powers.name: Mask of Flesh
powers.book: Dark Heresy — Disciples of the Dark Gods (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: You call upon the powers of the warp to alter your ﬂ esh and change your physical identity.

powers.name: Death’s Messenger
powers.book: Dark Heresy — Disciples of the Dark Gods (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: You tangle the skeins of destiny to deadly effect, causing others to fall before your assaults as if their deaths were preordained.

powers.name: Whispers of the Warp
powers.book: Dark Heresy — Disciples of the Dark Gods (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: The echoing whispers of the warp amplify your persuasive abilities to preternatural levels.

powers.name: Daemon Wrack
powers.book: Dark Heresy — Disciples of the Dark Gods (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: By weaving a pattern of warp energies, the sorcerer may attempt to repel or ensnare and seize command of daemonic entities.

powers.name: Hellish Blast
powers.book: Dark Heresy — Disciples of the Dark Gods (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: Use this power to hurl a burst of raw destructive energy channelled from the warp at your victim, burning and blasting him apart.

powers.name: Holocaust of Torment
powers.book: Dark Heresy — Disciples of the Dark Gods (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.range: 10 metre radius extending from the Maiden
powers.effect: of Pain The agony and despair felt moment-by-moment by the victim of a Maiden of Pain (see page 131) is unimaginable—held in undying torment between life and death, between the gnawing of daemons at his soul and the ravages of a bodily exti

powers.name: Black Channelling
powers.book: Dark Heresy — Disciples of the Dark Gods (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: The sorcerer draws on the twisting power of the warp to embolden and sustain daemonic creatures in the area, cementing their grip on reality and bolstering their power.

powers.name: Storm of Malignancy
powers.book: Dark Heresy — Disciples of the Dark Gods (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: Drawing on psychically echoed waves of malice, paranoia, and hatred from the warp, the sorcerer can fill the hearts and minds of the unsuspecting with sudden rage, panic, and spite with lethal consequences.

powers.name: Revelation of Truth
powers.book: Dark Heresy — Disciples of the Dark Gods (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: The sorcerer bends reality around himself, warping time and filling the air with a tumult of daemonic whispers and phantasmal images.

powers.name: Time Distortion
powers.book: Dark Heresy — Disciples of the Dark Gods (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: The sorcerer sets himself fractionally out of phase with the flow of reality and time around him, appearing to blur and shift with shadowy double images of his possible past and future actions flowing around him like ghosts.

powers.name: Blade of Baleful Might
powers.book: Black Crusade — Tome of Fate (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: The sorcerer’s force weapon exhibits terrifying qualities of destruction and menace.

powers.name: Butcher’s Offering
powers.book: Black Crusade — Tome of Fate (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: As the sorcerer cuts through his enemies with unnatural vigour, he takes a moment to make an offering to the Dark Gods in all their glory.

powers.name: Echoes of Malice
powers.book: Black Crusade — Tome of Fate (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: The warp is a repository of unfettered emotion, dense with energy ever engaged in a turbulent dance.

powers.name: Harrier Imps
powers.book: Black Crusade — Tome of Fate (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: Harrier Imps are a swarm of minor daemons that press up against the barrier between reality and the warp that laugh at and harry the poor soul vexed by their presence.

powers.name: Hex of Decrepitude
powers.book: Black Crusade — Tome of Fate (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: In the warp, time flows according to its own unlogic.

powers.name: Phantom Parry
powers.book: Black Crusade — Tome of Fate (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: As an enemy sorcerer draws on the warp to fuel a psychic power, the psyker may respond by disturbing the veil with a Phantom Parry, causing his foe’s control to falter and allow the warp loose to corrupt the fragile materium.

powers.name: Umbral Halo
powers.book: Black Crusade — Tome of Fate (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: The psyker summons a black halo around his head, wrought from his own corrupt soul.

powers.name: Warp Vortex
powers.book: Black Crusade — Tome of Fate (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: A vortex of energy emerges to collect all matter within its core; men fall towards it as air rushes past and a small sphere of debris forms at its devastating centre.

powers.name: Acidium Vitae
powers.book: Black Crusade — Tome of Fate (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: The psyker’s very blood and breath course with poison and disease, punishing his enemies for daring to attack him.

powers.name: Brain Fever
powers.book: Black Crusade — Tome of Fate (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: A rapidly progressing fever takes the target of this power, rendering him unable to think and slow to respond.

powers.name: Corpse Burst
powers.book: Black Crusade — Tome of Fate (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: Of the more resourceful of Nurgle’s followers are those sorcerers who have mastered the art of the Corpse Burst.

powers.name: Dirge of Decay
powers.book: Black Crusade — Tome of Fate (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.prerequisites: Aligned Nurgle, Disturbing Voice, Psy Rating 4
powers.effect: As the devotee of Nurgle intones the Dirge of Decay, wounded combatants howl in a chorus as rot and infection take them.

powers.name: Tendrils of Corrosion
powers.book: Black Crusade — Tome of Fate (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: Though decomposition and disease of the body are more recognisably the work of the Lord of Decay, corrosion and entropy in their broadest form are also his purview.

powers.name: Vile Contagion
powers.book: Black Crusade — Tome of Fate (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: Nurgle’s Rot spreads across the battlefield adding disease to bloodshed as far as the eye can see.

powers.name: Ward of Worms
powers.book: Black Crusade — Tome of Fate (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: Putrid, olive green worms continually squirm from the mouth, nose, and ears of the sorcerer and writhe about his body covering his armour in necrotic slime.

powers.name: Cedron’s Twin
powers.book: Black Crusade — Tome of Fate (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: The power of the warp to shape the desires of the psychically attuned have few limits.

powers.name: Celeritous Sense
powers.book: Black Crusade — Tome of Fate (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: The sorcerer hones his senses, directing the flows of light and sound such that he can take in every nuanced detail.

powers.name: Pangs of Misery
powers.book: Black Crusade — Tome of Fate (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: The Heretic reaches deeply through the target’s mind and burrows into his pain centres.

powers.name: Serpent’s Ward
powers.book: Black Crusade — Tome of Fate (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: This beguiling ward gifts the psyker with an alluring gaze, causing enemies to forget themselves and the dangers about them.

powers.name: The Six Blades of Prosepheron
powers.book: Black Crusade — Tome of Fate (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: To suffer defeat at the hands of the Six Blades of Prosepheron at least makes for a quick, if painful, death.

powers.name: Unnatural Obsession
powers.book: Black Crusade — Tome of Fate (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: The subject of this power loses all sense of reality and becomes obsessively and irrationally devoted to the psyker.

powers.name: Æther Worm
powers.book: Black Crusade — Tome of Fate (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: The Master of Plots dines off of the webs of mistrust and errors in faith engendered by those who conspire and politic throughout the galaxy.

powers.name: Befuddling Curse
powers.book: Black Crusade — Tome of Fate (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: A multihued bolt of light leaps from the sorcerer and strikes the target with no apparent effect.

powers.name: Blessing of Magnus
powers.book: Black Crusade — Tome of Fate (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: The Thousand Sons have survived many a difficult trial in the past ten thousand years they have plied the galaxy.

powers.name: Fate Loom
powers.book: Black Crusade — Tome of Fate (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: Sorcerers use this power as a last ditch effort by forcing fate’s hand to accomplish goals that would otherwise be impossible.

powers.name: Incendiary of Tzeentch
powers.book: Black Crusade — Tome of Fate (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: These sorcerous shells race towards their enemies in blue-white fire, exploding on impact, and not only damage the flesh but the spirit itself in unholy flame.

powers.name: Labyrinthine Conundrum
powers.book: Black Crusade — Tome of Fate (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: The power infects the target’s mind, weighing down his thoughts and possibly disabling his thinking altogether as he attempts to solve an insolvable enigma.

powers.name: Mask of Deceit
powers.book: Black Crusade — Tome of Fate (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: The Great Conspirator constructed every worthwhile tool in the machinations of politics, some mundane, and others feats of legendary power.

powers.name: Storm of Change
powers.book: Black Crusade — Tome of Fate (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: The psyker summons an army of aerial fire to descend on his enemies.

powers.name: Warp-flame Ward
powers.book: Black Crusade — Tome of Fate (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: The psyker calls on the Changer of Ways to wrap his form in arcane energies.

powers.name: Aegis of Euphedros
powers.book: Black Crusade — Tome of Fate (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: Few have witnessed the Aegis of Euphedros and survived, but those who have recount it among the most impressive feats of sorcery ever.

powers.name: Unbalanced Mind
powers.book: Black Crusade — Tome of Fate (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: Nothing vexes the sorcerer more than having his mind come undone whilst channelling his powers.

powers.name: Wither Hex
powers.book: Black Crusade — Tome of Fate (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: On the world of Q’sal, decrepitude and infirmity plague the dreams of those who have never experienced it, for on Q’sal, the extremes of age are occulted from view.

powers.name: Blood Boil
powers.book: Black Crusade — Tome of Fate (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: The psyker attunes himself to the circulation of blood in his victim, slowly but surely increasing the pressure of the flow.

powers.name: Cellular Control
powers.book: Black Crusade — Tome of Fate (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: There is no telling how often its own limits cause the body to fail in the face of the horrors of the Screaming Vortex.

powers.name: Chitin Shell
powers.book: Black Crusade — Tome of Fate (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: Scavenging from his own body’s nutrients, bone, and muscle, the psyker constructs organic protective plating to defend weak points left open by his synthetic armour.

powers.name: Flesh Mould
powers.book: Black Crusade — Tome of Fate (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: For those who can master this power, will and body become one.

powers.name: Last Breath
powers.book: Black Crusade — Tome of Fate (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: Suffocation invokes a degree of terror above and beyond many of the other violations one can commit against the body of another.

powers.name: Neural Storm
powers.book: Black Crusade — Tome of Fate (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: Drawing on and enhancing the natural electrical currents of the psyker’s nervous system, he summons a bolt of power to shock his enemies.

powers.name: Regeneration
powers.book: Black Crusade — Tome of Fate (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.sustained: Full Action or Half Action, see below
powers.effect: Of the many feats of biomancy, Regeneration perhaps ranks second in power to the act of creating life itself.

powers.name: Sharpened Senses
powers.book: Black Crusade — Tome of Fate (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: The gift of the Sharpened Senses grants the psyker senses more fitting a beast than a human.

powers.name: Toxic Siphon
powers.book: Black Crusade — Tome of Fate (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: When poison or other toxins enter the body and a dose of de-tox is not available, Toxic Siphon can work as a painful, if effective alternative.

powers.name: Unnatural Healing
powers.book: Black Crusade — Tome of Fate (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: The body’s capacity to heal itself, closing wounds and regenerating tissue, sometimes fails to match the rate at which the universe sends agents to destroy it.

powers.name: Manifest Flame
powers.book: Black Crusade — Tome of Fate (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: The most basic of the pyromancer’s talents, this is nevertheless one of the most difficult to master.

powers.name: Fire Bolt
powers.book: Black Crusade — Tome of Fate (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: A simple trick, the psyker flicks a bolt of fire he has manifested or finds conveniently nearby at a foe.

powers.name: Fire Barrage
powers.book: Black Crusade — Tome of Fate (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: A more complicated and nuanced version of the simple fire bolt, the psyker catches up multiple bolts of fire from a single source and hurls them in a buzzing swarm at his intended target.

powers.name: Fire Storm
powers.book: Black Crusade — Tome of Fate (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: The psyker summons an intense conflagration from a single source and hurls it through the air at his target.

powers.name: Incinerate
powers.book: Black Crusade — Tome of Fate (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.prerequisites: Manifest Flame, One with the Flame
powers.effect: Truly one of the most difficult tricks of the pyromantic sorcerer is the ability to call forth the inner flame of another being, incinerating them from within.

powers.name: Molten Man
powers.book: Black Crusade — Tome of Fate (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.prerequisites: Psy Rating 6, At least four other
powers.effect: To have transcended the physical form and become an avatar of pure energy is no simple feat, and thus only the wisest and most learned have mastered such a trick.

powers.name: One with the Flame
powers.book: Black Crusade — Tome of Fate (WH40K Roleplay)
powers.effect: The Sok’caleth of Q’Sal are particularly infamous for their ability to control the flames around them through sinuous, flowing dances as the flames respond to their every gesture.

powers.name: Deus Ex Ferrum
powers.effect: The Iron Hands Librarian focuses his mind and links his iron will to the strength of his augmetics, bolstering himself and his allies.

powers.name: Betrayal of Flesh
powers.effect: Harnessing his hatred for weakness, the Iron Hands Librarian sunders the flesh of his enemies with a blast of psychic power, reducing his enemies to dust.

powers.name: Punish the Weak
powers.effect: After fighting alongside his Iron Hands Battle- Brothers for countless battles, the Librarian has learned how to spare their mechanical bodies while assailing his enemies.

powers.name: Corax’s Ingenuity
powers.effect: The Librarian plunges his mind into the Warp, harnessing its power.

powers.name: Curse of the Raven
powers.effect: The Librarian curses an opponent, condemning him to death at the hands of the Emperor’s champions.

powers.name: The Unkindness of Deliverance
powers.effect: The Librarian manifests his psychic power as an unkindness of ravens.

powers.name: Fury of the Salamander
powers.effect: The Librarian conjures the flame and fury of his home world and the terrible lizards that dwell upon it, and drives it towards his enemies.

powers.name: Heat of the Furnace
powers.effect: The searing heat of the forge runs through the veins of the Salamanders, and the Librarian can turn that heat outwards, wreathing himself in flame that enemies cannot bear to be near, and which causes flesh to burn and blister at his touch.

powers.name: Nocturne’s Fire
powers.effect: The volcanic fury of Nocturne is a deep and powerful force, and terrifying when fully unleashed.

powers.name: Vulkan’s Anvil
powers.effect: The Librarian draws upon the unyielding endurance that the Salamanders are legendary for, becoming an anvil against the attacks of his enemies.

powers.name: Heart of the Khan
powers.effect: The Stormseer reaches deep into the legacy of Jaghatai Khan, and brings forth the legendary swiftness and ferocity of the White Scars’ Primarch.

powers.name: Spirits of the Steppes
powers.effect: The Stormseer calls upon the spirits of the land, air, and the souls of long-dead warriors to bring some fragment of the harsh steppes of Chogoris to the battlefield he walks upon.

powers.name: Stormlance
powers.effect: The Stormseer calls upon the lightning that embodies his Chapter’s way of war, and brings it to bear against his enemies.

powers.name: The Howling Wind
powers.effect: The Stormseer gathers the powerful winds of the Chogorian steppes, driving them forwards to cast aside the enemy.
